name: LeftLion - Notts What I Call Music 2026
instructions: Email the Bandcamp/SoundCloud/Spotify link to music@, plus cover image, release date if unreleased, band info and website/social links. Gig reviews: email well in advance.
notes: Nottingham culture magazine; annual playlist of Notts acts by LeftLion. Send-us-music page is for Nottingham bands; strongest local fit if FloodLines can claim a Notts connection. Page dates from 2019.

name: The Line of Best Fit - new music discovery
instructions: New and unsigned artists submit via the music submission form; news@ is for news/press releases, not music.
notes: Major UK new-music site; very competitive.

name: DIY - The Neu Playlist
instructions: For Neu / new band coverage, email the whole editorial team; pitches are discussed at weekly meetings.
notes: Contacts page lists sarah@, emma@ and daisy@diymag.com; cc all three as the page asks. Sister playlist 'Essential New Tracks' also exists.

name: Fresh On The Net - Fresh Faves
instructions: One public SoundCloud track per week via the submit page; inbox opens Monday and closes Wednesday evening or at 200 tracks; no remixes.
notes: Free, run by volunteers (founded by Tom Robinson). Weekly Fresh Faves sets; inbox was closed until 16 Nov at research time. No email submissions.

name: Fresh On The Net - Alt Picks
instructions: Same weekly inbox as Fresh Faves: one public SoundCloud track per week, Monday to Wednesday or first 200.
notes: Alternative-leaning weekly set from the same submissions; one submission covers both.

name: Indie Is Not A Genre - Best of Indie 2026
instructions: Submissions only through the SubmitHub widget on the submit page.
notes: Focus on new indie bands from the UK and elsewhere. SubmitHub premium credits cost money (standard credits may be free).

name: When The Horn Blows - Weekly Top Tracks
instructions: Send music via the SubmitHub 'Send us your music' widget on the About/Contact page.
notes: UK blog covering indie, folk, singer-songwriter, rock and electronic pop. Playlist posts on the site date from 2019-2020, so the playlist may be inactive. Staff emails on the page are for features/reviews, not an explicit music inbox.

name: Radio Wigwam - Spin of the Month
instructions: Upload tracks through a Radio Wigwam artist account; free tier allows 1 submission a month, Premiere tier is paid (GBP 5/month).
notes: Indie and unsigned radio. A new 'Spin of the Month' playlist is made each month (June 2026 shown; Linktree lists up to November 2026). Ignore the unofficial 'Best Indie and Alt Rock Wigwam' playlist.

name: Mystic Sons - Singles Club
instructions: Email info@; a follow-up nudge is fine. To guarantee a response they suggest SubmitHub or Groover (paid).
notes: Indie label/collective based at Strongroom Studios.

name: So Young Magazine - The So Young List
instructions: No submission instructions found; only a general contact address on the About page.
notes: Underground UK guitar music, strong stylistic fit, but the page does not invite music by email.

name: Obscure Sound - Emerging Indie Rock
instructions: Email with subject 'Obscure Sound Submission': streaming link, press photo, brief background. No AI-written pitches or AI music.
notes: Blog also takes SubmitHub/MusoSoup (paid); email route is free.

name: Post-Trash Weekly
instructions: Submissions go to editor Dan Goldin by email.
notes: Email is written obfuscated on the page ('dgoldin2012 at gmail dot com'). Weekly playlist of the site's favourite new music; Exploding in Sound-adjacent indie/alt rock.

name: KEXP - New This Week
instructions: Email md@kexp.org: streaming + WAV download links (no attachments), artist info, focus tracks, release date.
notes: Submission is for station airplay; KEXP playlists draw from rotation. Seattle.

name: KEXP Rotation
instructions: Same route as KEXP New This Week: md@kexp.org with streaming + WAV links, no attachments.
notes: One submission covers both KEXP rows; don't send twice.

name: BIRP! Indie Pop / Rock Playlist (monthly)
instructions: Email submit@birp.fm per the submit page.
notes: Optional paid $5 review buys a guaranteed 48h response only (not placement); free email route exists. Monthly playlist URL changes each month.

name: Indiemono - Alternative Weekly 2026
instructions: Free form: released songs only, Spotify track link, 1-3 tags. Submits to all Indiemono playlists; feedback not guaranteed.
notes: Madrid-based. Follower count from indiemono.com playlist page.

name: Indiemono - Alt Rock 2026
instructions: Same free form as Alternative Weekly; one submission goes to all Indiemono playlists.
notes: Follower count from indiemono.com playlist page.

name: For The Love Of Bands - NEW ROCK 2026
instructions: Form: name, email, Spotify URL, genre, mood, for fans of, release date, location, playlist choice. Track must be under 3 months old.
notes: Free 'regular' option; optional paid skip-the-queue (merch/donation) exists, not required.

name: For The Love Of Bands - NEW INDIE MUSIC / Indie Radar
instructions: Same form as NEW ROCK; pick this playlist in the selection. Track under 3 months old.
notes: Free regular route; paid skip-the-queue optional.

name: Pinguin Radio - Radar
instructions: Submit via Musisum (free to start), as named on Pinguin's about page.
notes: Station prefers 'bands en gitaren'; tracks not aired may go to their public Spotify playlists, e.g. 'Penguin Artists Showcase - New Releases' (1vlE5pdwDWhJuiNEFrfJx1).

name: Louder Than War - John Robb LTW playlist
instructions: New artists: email the New Releases Editor a stream or download link and a one-line description of your sound, at least a month before release.
notes: Punk/alt lean. Weekly LTW playlists are also posted on Steady.

name: Punktastic - New Music Friday
instructions: Contact page says sending music via 'The Pickup' (send-us-music) or the news desk is usually the best way to get featured.
notes: Punk/emo/alt-rock lean. The send-us-music link redirects to thepickup.punktastic.com, which had an expired TLS certificate at research time, so the form itself could not be read.

name: Punktastic - The Punktastic Podcast (The Pickup)
instructions: Same route as above: submit to The Pickup.
notes: Playlist of bands featured on the podcast. Same unreadable-form caveat.

name: Neon Music - Indie Vibes
instructions: Pitch via SubmitHub Direct from the playlists page (paid, from about USD 4).
notes: SubmitHub link: https://www.submithub.com/direct/neon-music?source=playlists-indievibes. Sister playlist 'New Music 2026: Emerging Artists' (3OLN0idZDEa1nlts06liBQ).

name: Primordial Radio - Primordial Presents
instructions: Fill in the 'Send Us Your Music' form (band info, socials, Dropbox/Drive download link) to be considered for the station playlist.
notes: Rock and metal station; new-bands show and playlist. Heavier than FloodLines' indie lean.

name: Overblown - Ob Picks
instructions: Only a general 'we'd love to hear from you' contact; no submission guidance.
notes: Email shown but music submissions by email are not explicitly invited.

name: God Is In The TV - Tracks of the Week
instructions: Contact page lists the New Music Editor's email; no explicit submission wording.
notes: Playlist found is 'Tracks of the Week 2024' by editor Bill Cummings; weekly TOTW posts continue in 2026 but a 2026 playlist was not found.

name: Dork - HYPE: the best new artists
instructions: Contact page lists editor emails only; no music submission route.
notes: New-artist playlist from Dork; no submission route found.

name: Upset - UPSET: disrupt the noise
instructions: No submission route found.
notes: Rock/punk/emo magazine (Dork's sister title); playlist is owned by the Dork account.

name: Live4ever - The New Music Guide
instructions: No submission route found; contact page returned 404.
notes: Playlist linked from the site footer; mixes established and new indie/alt.

name: Nialler9 - Best New Music
instructions: Contact page blocked (403) at research time; route unknown.
notes: Also runs 'Best New Irish Music' (1Qbwx5vrJlWKBXIeyFBBDV), which is Irish-only.

name: Scruff of the Neck - Singles / Best New Music
instructions: Artist contact form asks for name, interest (live shows / Scruff Records / other), genre, comparable artists, age range, UK base and hometown; no music link.
notes: /submit redirects straight to the Google Form. Linked playlist is their label singles; their 'Best New Music' playlist (about 7.5k followers per their own post) URL was not found. Also run 'Spotlight' new-band gigs.

name: KUTX Song of the Day
instructions: Subject 'KUTX Song of the Day': WAV, 1-2 photos, send 2+ weeks before release.
notes: Austin artists take precedence.

name: XPN Best New Music
instructions: Use WXPN's music submission form.
notes: Philadelphia public radio; AAA format.

name: WNXP New Music Experience
instructions: Email a download link to 44.1k/16-bit WAV; no MP3s.
notes: Nashville public radio.

name: Gorilla vs Bear - best songs of 2026
instructions: Email submissions to chris@gorillavsbear.net.
notes: Leans indie/dream pop; year-end style playlist.

name: Atwood Magazine - Weekly Roundup 2026
instructions: Pitch for coverage via the email on the pitching page.
notes: Page says they don't take pitches for weekly roundups: email is for editorial coverage, playlist follows coverage. Email obfuscated on page (mitch[at]atwoodmagazine[dot]com).

name: Audiotree - New Releases
instructions: Audiotree Artist Submission form (linked from contact page).
notes: Form is for Audiotree Live session consideration; playlist features session releases, not open track pitches. Chicago.

name: Soho Radio - show playlists
instructions: Contact page lists 'Music submission: music@sohoradiolondon.com'.
notes: Route is for radio play; the station's Spotify playlists are show archives (this one from 2018), not new-music playlists.

name: Backseat Mafia - New Music
instructions: Be succinct, offer premieres/exclusives, pitch upcoming (not months-old) releases, link the song; no AI-generated music. Contact form on the page.
notes: Playlist found is 'New Music 2021'; no current new-music playlist found. Form is the on-page contact form.

name: GoldenPlec - Fresh Fridays (New Irish Music)
instructions: Submit singles/videos via the form for new music features, playlist inclusion or podcast/radio plays; Irish submissions get priority.
notes: Irish-focused playlist.

name: First Music Contact - Made in Ireland
instructions: Email a Spotify link plus a press release or short description of the music and background.
notes: Irish artists only.

name: Chordblossom - Fresh Music From Northern Ireland
instructions: Acts from Northern Ireland or the Republic email irish@; do not use it if not from Ireland.
notes: Irish/NI acts only; listed for completeness.

name: Hot Press - New Irish Songs To Hear This Week
instructions: No submission route found.
notes: Irish-focused.

name: Clash - Word of Mouth
instructions: Contact page lists staff emails only; no music route.
notes: Only Spotify playlist on Clash's Linktree; skews hip-hop/R&B. Next Wave playlist exists on Apple Music.

name: Lefuturewave - New Finds
instructions: Free form (name, email, message); SubmitHub/Groover/One Submit also offered.
notes: Pop-leaning indie blog.

name: Happy Mag - New Indie Music: Happy's Mixtape
instructions: Use Happy Mag's submit-music page.
notes: Playlist description says new Australian music, so UK acts are a long shot.

name: FBi Radio
instructions: Email music@fbiradio.com per the music submissions page.
notes: 50% Australian quota; only playlist found is the old 'FBi Turns 20'. Mainly an airplay route.

name: Glide Magazine - monthly Caustic Commentary
instructions: Physical mail: Glide Magazine, PO Box 1597, Scottsdale, AZ 85252.
notes: Post only; monthly playlist URL changes.

name: Northern Transmissions - monthly playlist
instructions: No submission route found; contact page lists only an editor email with no submission invite.
notes: Linked playlist is April 2025; monthly playlists.
